evidence_quotes.section1_quid_pro_quo: Rep never frames the call as 10-15 minutes with a dependable quote or asks for a yes before proceeding. Opens directly into delivery details.
evidence_quotes.section1_discovery_basics: Rep mentions moving date (thirtieth/Wednesday) and item count (hundred boxes) but does not ask for customer name, origin/destination cities, or home size in this call—those came from earlier virtual walkthrough.
evidence_quotes.section2_their_agenda: Never asked. Rep launches into estimate and logistics without asking 'what are your biggest concerns about this move.'
evidence_quotes.section3_logistics: Storage unit ground floor confirmed; large cabinet assembly question raised by rep (not customer). Packing services and box-count protocol never offered or discussed.
evidence_quotes.section4_estimate_anchor: $2,304 (6 hrs) to $2,688 (7 hrs), personalized by furniture size and walking distance: 'depending on walking distance from parking to the storage unit to the house that's you know, all of those information already accounted for as well.'
evidence_quotes.section4_pricing_framing: Two-and-a-half hour minimum, 15-minute intervals disclosed. All-inclusive (no credit card fees, transportation fees, foreman, trucks, wraps, insurance, assembly/reassembly) explicitly stated: 'that's all inclusive rates already like everything we need is already in that price.'
evidence_quotes.section4_feels_fair: Never asked 'does that feel fair?' Rep moves directly to 'would you guys like, or help with this move on that thirtieth or?'
evidence_quotes.section5_on_time: 'if we run late, we provide discounts by the end of the day.'
evidence_quotes.section5_damage: 'we include the $2,000 coverage already with the pricing that we offer' and '$2,000 coverage for any repair replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages.' No explicit deductible/no-fine-print framing.
evidence_quotes.section5_closes_loop: Does not ask if the two promises put concerns to rest. Moves into booking.
evidence_quotes.section6_final_concerns: Asks 'Do you have any questions so far?' (throwaway version, not genuine 'what's still concerning you?'). Customer responds with PO request, not a concern.
evidence_quotes.section7_explicit_ask: 'would you guys like, or help with this move on that thirtieth or?' — softened with the 'or' and trailing off, built-in escape.
evidence_quotes.section7_booking: Arrival window (8:30–9:00 AM), storage destination (ground floor), crew size (4 movers, 2 trucks) confirmed. Phone/email address pulled from prior contact but not re-confirmed. No crew notes about customer concerns left.

top_strength: Joanna delivered a fully transparent, itemized estimate ($2,304–$2,688) anchored to actual job details and backed by comprehensive all-inclusive pricing disclosure and both warranty promises (On-Time + $2,000 No Worries coverage).
coaching_note: This call skipped Section 1's quid-pro-quo framing and Section 2's agenda discovery entirely—start every call with 'This will take 10–15 minutes, you'll walk away with a quote you can depend on, does that sound good?' and ask 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' before diving into logistics.
